system.description:
Kelvan are the bell-keepers. Their tradition teaches that sound carries meaning across the Veil more cleanly than sight, and ritual bells accompany funerals, exorcisms, grave vigils and the investigation of restless dead.
Kelvan bells are intensely personal objects. Some are inherited through families while others are forged for a specific individual and buried with them. Different tones may indicate warning, mourning, safe passage or challenge. A trained Kelvan can often recognise another community's funerary practice merely from its bells. Their Sacred Toll represents the most direct expression of a tradition founded upon the belief that even the dead can sometimes be reminded that their mortal time has ended.
You gain Sacred Toll.
SACRED TOLL
AUDITORY DIVINITY FOCUS
Action 1 AP; Range 30 feet; Target one Undead or Unliving creature that can hear you
The target attempts a level-based Will saving throw.
Heroic/Critical The target is unaffected.
Success The target is unaffected.
Partial The target becomes frightened 1 until the end of its next turn.
Failure The target becomes frightened 2 until the end of its next turn.
Fumble The target becomes frightened 2 and cannot use reactions until the end of its next turn.
Blunder The target becomes frightened 3 and cannot use reactions until the end of its next turn.
